q: The Birkhoff ergodic theorem for the Gauss map implies that for Lebesgue-a.e. α, the partial quotients aₙ of the continued fraction of α satisfy:
opts: (1/n) Σᵢ aᵢ → Khinchin's constant (the geometric mean)
(1/n) Σᵢ log aᵢ → log K (where K is Khinchin's constant)
exp: Birkhoff for the Gauss map with Gauss measure: (1/n) Σᵢ log aᵢ(α) → ∫₀¹ log⌊1/x⌋ dμ_Gauss(x) = log K / log 2 for a.e. α. Hence the geometric mean (a₁…aₙ)^{1/n} → K ≈ 2.685 (Khinchin's constant). The arithmetic mean is infinite (since E_Gauss[a₁] = ∞).
